title: Installation Jobs: Contract Discount Programs on Interior Casing
content:
**Discount programs carried over to interior casing — Installation Jobs**

The discount program on the contract an **Installation Jobs** record installs carries over to new interior casing, at the rate that contract's series sets for that program. The contract is the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract of a window job, or the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract of a door job, and the program is the discount program recorded on it.

| Discount program on the contract the job installs | Program rate carried to the casing |
|---|---|
| military | the series military rate |
| first-responder | the series first-responder rate |
| senior | the series senior rate |
| no program | nothing |

The series rates are those the contract's own series sets for each program; the program rate forms part of the casing discount rate.

## Cases (hypothetical contracts)

- A window contract in a series whose first-responder rate is 7 percent carries the first-responder program: the casing takes 7 percent.
- A contract carrying the military program takes its own series' military rate.
- A contract with no discount program: no program rate.
